name: Turbo Guns speeds up Mechsuit: Combustion and boosts Combustion's damage (#758)
contract: #758: Turbo Guns 520809 is a native spell-modifier passive with three effects. Effect 0 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), EffectMiscValue 10 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, BasePoints -251 DieSides 1 (-250 ms), EffectSpellClassMask (0,0,1073741824) = bit 94, which in family 34 is Mechsuit: Combustion 801387 (SpellFamilyFlags (0,0,1073745920) = bits 76 and 94, CastingTimeIndex 16 = 1500 ms, AttributesEx3 0), so it casts in 1250 ms. Effect 2 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), EffectMiscValue 0 SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, BasePoints 19 DieSides 1 (+20%), mask (0,0,16384) = bit 78, which is the triggered Combustion 801388 (flags (0,4096,16384)), whose effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE and whose amount passes Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone. 520809 is not one of the modifier ids the family-34 routing switch in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod returns for, so it falls through to the ordinary class-mask test. The two masks point at different spells on purpose: 801387 itself deals no damage (effect 0 is a trigger-with-value) and must stay unmodified by the damage percentage. Effect 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION -2000 ms on bit 94) is inert because 801387 has DurationIndex 0 and no aura effect; it is not asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Mechsuit: Combustion casts in 1500 ms without Turbo Guns
Combustion's damage is unmodified without Turbo Guns
Turbo Guns cuts Mechsuit: Combustion's cast time to 1250 ms
Turbo Guns raises the triggered Combustion's damage by 20%
The damage percentage does not reach the Mechsuit helper itself
